name: Sentinel
ability: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.
setup: Before tokens go in the bag, the Storyteller may add an Outsider and remove a Townsfolk, remove an Outsider and add a Townsfolk, or do neither.
interaction: Declared publicly at the start; no player interaction.
drunk_or_poisoned: Fabled cannot be drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: Used when a script's Outsider count would otherwise be known, so evil can bluff Outsiders.
Combines with other setup modifiers such as the Baron.

test_scenarios.name: with Baron
test_scenarios.expected: Baron +2 and Sentinel -1: 4 Townsfolk, 3 Outsiders, 1 Minion, 1 Demon.
